mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_timesheet t JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND p.manager_id = #{userId}) AS "timesheetToApprove", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_task WHERE assignee_id = #{userId} AND status <> 'DONE' AND plan_end < #{today}) AS "taskOverdue"
